worldbinder.export.notes.server_import:
WorldBinder Server Import Notes
===============================

This export includes normal root world folders and modern 26.x dimension mirrors.
For Paper/Multiverse imports, use a lowercase world name. The generated server dimension mirror(s): %s

If Paper logs java.nio.file.AccessDeniedException for region files, the files are present but the server process cannot read them.
Stop the server and fix file ownership/permissions before importing again. On Linux this usually means chown/chmod through your panel or host.
A restart alone does not fix wrong ownership.

WorldBinder Vanilla Export
==========================

Created: %s
Archive: %s
Minecraft: %s
Target output: %s (%s)
Chunks: %s
Blocks: %s
Block entities: %s
Entities: %s

This folder contains a vanilla-shaped save: level.dat, region/*.mca, entities/*.mca where supported, poi/*.mca where supported and resources.zip when available.
Only data actually seen/captured by the client can be exported. Server-hidden data cannot be reconstructed.

Copy the entire folder into Minecraft saves, or use your server import tools. Server world keys: `%s`. Check spawn, first loaded chunks and target-version compatibility after import.
